title.value: An act to add Chapter 13.5 (commencing with Section 108970) to Part 3 of Division 104 of the Health and Safety Code, relating to public health.

location.provenance: The people of the State of California do enact as follows:

status.provenance: Approved by Governor September 29, 2022. Filed with Secretary of State September 29, 2022.

date.provenance: Approved by Governor September 29, 2022. Filed with Secretary of State September 29, 2022.

pfas_definition.provenance: (e) 'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: no person shall manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state any new, not previously used, textile articles that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS

date.provenance: commencing January 1, 2025, no person shall manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state any new, not previously used, textile articles that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS

who.provenance: no person shall manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state any new, not previously used, textile articles that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS

action.provenance: no person shall manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state any new, not previously used, textile articles that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS

products.provenance: (i) (1) 'Textile articles' means textile goods of a type customarily and ordinarily used in households and businesses, and include, but are not limited to, apparel, accessories, handbags, backpacks, draperies, shower curtains, furnishings, upholstery, beddings, towels, napkins, and tablecloths.

value: outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions until January 1, 2028
clothing items for exclusive use by the United States military
treatments containing PFAS for use on converted textiles or leathers
filtration media and filter products used in industrial applications
textile articles used in or for laboratory analysis and testing
stadium shades or other architectural fabric structures
exceptions.provenance: (2) Paragraph (1) does not apply to outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions until January 1, 2028. (A) Any of the following items regulated under the Safer Consumer Products Program...

intentionally_added.provenance: (g) (1) 'Regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS' means PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect in the product

type.provenance: it is accompanied by a legible and easily discernable disclosure with the statement 'Made with PFAS chemicals,' including for online listings of products for sale.

date.provenance: commencing January 1, 2025, no person shall distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state any new, not previously used, outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS unless it is accompanied by a legible and easily discernable disclosure

who.provenance: no person shall distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state any new, not previously used, outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS unless it is accompanied by a legible and easily discernable disclosure

action.provenance: no person shall distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state any new, not previously used, outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS unless it is accompanied by a legible and easily discernable disclosure

value: outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions
products.provenance: (d) 'Outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions' means outdoor apparel that are extreme and extended use products designed for outdoor sports experts for applications that provide protection against extended exposure to extreme rain conditions or against extended immersion in water or wet conditions

intentionally_added.provenance: (g) (1) 'Regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS' means PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect in the product
